thread:
ana: Quick design run: unify SDK prefetch + fallback surfaces. We want predictable defaults, clear opt-ins, and language-friendly ergonomics.

chris: Proposal: prefetch = none|adjacent|buffered. buffered takes prefetch_pages. fallback = none|stream|list_all (explicit opt-in).

raj: Key constraints: prefetch must be best-effort (separate retry budget), respect server capability flags (supports_streaming, supports_unary_list), and never change default failure semantics unless fallback enabled.

zoe: Language notes: Python/TS can keep iterator ergonomics; Go needs explicit Iterator.Close()/Cancel() to stop background prefetch goroutines. Provide examples in each SDK.

ana: Telemetry: counters for prefetch_attempted/succeeded/failed, fallback_invoked, prefetch_bytes. Traces should link to parent request id.

chris: Defaults: Hosted = prefetch:none, Dedicated/Private = prefetch:adjacent. Admins can override via org policy. Prefetch limits (pages/bytes) required for buffered/aggressive.

raj: Backoff/hedging: prefetch deadline shorter than primary. If prefetch fails swallow error; only surface if it impacts current page or fallback triggers. Recommend request-id header for dedupe when fallback runs.

zoe: Action items: add route capability flags, add callframe options in SDKs, implement background transport plumbing, docs + migration guide. I'll prototype Go iterator behavior.
